name: libwpe
notes: Added 2026-10-11 for Web Tranche 3B milestone B3. PlayStation-shaped ports (docs/acceptance/crtweb_acceptance.md, 3B plan) use libwpe for key-code conversion (WebCore/platform/libwpe/PlatformKeyboardEventLibWPE.cpp), the pasteboard and the view-backend interface; BSD-2-Clause, ~12 C files, no dependency of its own.
WPE_ENABLE_XKB=OFF: the xkbcommon helpers (wpe/input-xkb.h) are not needed; the 3A input contract carries XKB keysyms and keycodes already converted by the platform.
The shared library only dlopen()s the view backend (WPE_BACKEND / libWPEBackend-default.so) when a view backend is created; PlatformCRT provides it in B4.

-DHAVE_ANDROID_LOG_H=0 declares a toolchain capability: CRT's sysroot has <android/log.h> and the __android_log_* functions in libc, but no separate liblog to link, and libwpe would otherwise add -llog (its check_function_exists is vacuous under CRT's static-library try-compile). libwpe then logs with fprintf to stderr. Found while porting: the header declared __android_log_buf_write with no definition; libc now implements the Bionic liblog entry points (libc/src/android_api.c, libc/tests/android_log_test.c).

Built static (BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF), as the PlayStation port uses it: the shared build finds its view backend and pasteboard with dlopen(), which the CRT Linux libdl does not implement (docs/design/dynamic_loading.md), and a static libwpe has the embedder define _wpe_loader_interface instead (PlatformCRT's backend in B4).
macOS (2026-10-12 replay): ELF-only link flags are per-host overrides, test link lines name .dylib, and tests of shared libraries use the shared C runtime.

macOS (2026-10-12 replay): -D__unix__=1: the Khronos eglplatform.h picks its native types from __unix__ (or __APPLE__, which the CRT wrapper hides), and clang for Darwin defines neither __unix__ nor, here, __APPLE__, so libwpe's renderer-backend-egl.h stopped at 'Platform not recognized'.
